mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (order_id, amount, status, method, provider, idempotency_key, expires_at, approved_at, fail_reason, pg_tid, create_at, update_at, delete_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{method}, #{provider}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{expiresAt}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NOW(), NOW(), NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId, amount, status, method, provider, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, expires_at AS expiresAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, fail_reason AS failReason, pg_tid AS pgTid, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, delete_at AS deleteAt FROM payments WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND delete_at IS NULL

SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId, amount, status, method, provider, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, expires_at AS expiresAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, fail_reason AS failReason, pg_tid AS pgTid, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, delete_at AS deleteAt FROM payments WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND delete_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = 'PAID', pg_tid = #{pgTid}, approved_at = NOW(), update_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND delete_at IS NULL
UPDATE payments SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND delete_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId, amount, status, method, provider, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, expires_at AS expiresAt, fail_reason AS failReason, pg_tid AS pgTid, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, delete_at AS deleteAt FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND expires_at > NOW() AND delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
